purpose: Portable identity and temporal contract for future PostgreSQL migration with minimal maintenance.

id.rule: Names, labels, slugs, Scope assignments and classifications may change; id does not change.

foreign_keys.rule: Relationships should reference stable *_id fields instead of joining by mutable names, labels or filenames.

current_entity_time.created_at: first creation time; immutable once known
current_entity_time.effective_at: time from which the Current definition is authoritative

historical_event_time.occurred_at: time the historical event actually occurred, when known
historical_event_time.recorded_at: time the event/evidence was captured by the system
historical_event_time.entity_id: stable reference to the entity whose history is being described

timestamp_format.unknown_time_rule: Use null when an exact time is unknown. Never invent a timestamp for backfill.

authority_direction.rule: Current Authority interprets History; History never defines Current Authority.

migration_strategy.phase_1: Enforce the contract for new and modified Current entities.
migration_strategy.phase_2: Backfill stable ids on existing Current entities without changing semantic meaning.
migration_strategy.phase_3: Backfill timestamps only where provenance supports them; otherwise keep null.
migration_strategy.phase_4: Map JSON ids to PostgreSQL PK/FK and timestamps to timestamptz.
